---
title: "Application Instructions"
---

## Step 1

[Click here to create an account](https://sis2.cut.ac.cy/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/zcut_wd_st_cr_account?sap-client=300&sap-language=EN#) and enter a valid e-mail address.

## Step 2

Follow the instructions you receive on your personal e-mail to create your profile in the system. Keep your access codes (username/password) to access the Portal.

## Step 3

From [https://sis.cut.ac.cy/irj/portal](https://sis.cut.ac.cy/irj/portal), enter your username and password to access the Portal and submit your application.

## Step 4

Select the *MSc Experiential and Digital Marketing Communications* programme and attach the required supporting documents.

---

::: {.callout-important}
1. Check your spam/junk/quarantine folders — system-generated emails often get mislaid.
2. Check your email regularly as we may request further documentation and send selection process updates.
:::

For questions, use the [application submission guide](https://www.cut.ac.cy/digitalAssets/76/76340_1Electronic_Application_for_CUT_Study_Programms__February_2022_.pdf) or contact:
